links.outcome: AI diagnostic performance across clinical and demographic subgroups (cluster analysis)
links.effect: Eight clusters identified; specificity stayed high (96.0-100.0%) with sensitivity varying only in one specific subgroup.
links.quote: Eight distinct clusters were identified, in which the model maintained high specificity (96.0-100.0%), with sensitivity varying only in one specific subgroup.

screen.reason: This study evaluates the real-world diagnostic performance and subgroup variability of a commercial CNN AI model (Eyer Maps) applied within a primary care teleophthalmology workflow, but does not test a specific deployment safeguard or practice.
